topic.title: Dyson Built 5,127 Vacuums Before One Worked

title: The Vacuum That Took 5,127 Tries Became Dyson
description:
How many failures would you take before you quit? James Dyson took thousands.
Sources: Gizmodo, Dyson (Dec 2025).
Based on public records and reporting. Not financial or legal advice.
